## About This Location

Welcome to Jackson Heights Library! Visit your local QPL branch for books, movies, music, free Wi-Fi, free computer workstations, classes, programs, and so much more.

No matter who you are, where you’re from, or where you want to go, at Queens Public Library, we speak your language.

Remote Printing is available at this QPL location. Visit <https://queenslib.org/qplprint> to learn more.

Learn about the services we provide at the [Jackson Heights Adult Learning Center](https://www.queenslibrary.org/programs-activities/adult-learners/adult-learning-centers/jackson-heights).

This QPL location has Extended Wi-Fi. If you’re within 450 feet of this branch, you can connect automatically to our wireless network, QPL\_Wi-Fi, whether we are open or closed, no sign-in required!

Seven-day service at this QPL location is **made possible by funding in the Fiscal Year 2026 NYC budget.**

#### Lefrak City Alert

Mobile Library service for the Lefrak City community is currently provided on 57th Avenue or on 99th Street, on Fridays from 10am to 5pm (except holidays).

We are excited to announce that the future location of Lefrak City Library will be at 95-15 Horace Harding Expressway.

Construction of the space has begun, and we anticipate the opening of the new branch in the fall of 2026.

Please continue to visit our website for updates.

## About This Location

Welcome to Elmhurst Library! Visit your local QPL branch for books, movies, music, free Wi-Fi, free computer workstations, classes, programs, and so much more.

No matter who you are, where you’re from, or where you want to go, at Queens Public Library, we speak your language.

Remote Printing is available at this QPL location. Visit <https://queenslib.org/qplprint> to learn more.

Learn about the services we provide at the [Elmhurst Adult Learning Center](https://www.queenslibrary.org/programs-activities/adult-learners/adult-learning-centers/elmhurst).

This QPL location has Extended Wi-Fi. If you’re within 450 feet of this branch, you can connect automatically to our wireless network, QPL\_Wi-Fi, whether we are open or closed, no sign-in required!
